already_green_acs: AC-8 (TinyHttpd default allowlist half): absolute-form targets naming evil.example or h already get 421 from TinyHttpd's DNS-rebinding Host allowlist before middleware, with no backend connection, at base
declared_limits: AC-8 servlet adapter half is not tested: the proxy module's test classpath has only NaruServe-api testFixtures and NaruServe-tinyhttpd (build.gradle is outside this lane's write set). The servlet adapter derives rawPath from HttpServletRequest.getRequestURI(), which the Servlet spec defines as the path without scheme/host, so the proxy check runs on the path; a servlet-container test belongs to a lane allowed to add testImplementation project(':NaruServe-servlet').

AC-8 TinyHttpd: with the default allowlist an absolute-form target naming a host not on the allowlist gets 421 from the adapter before the proxy runs; the proxy's own 400 for GET http://h/api/orders/%2e%2e/x is observed only when h is allowlisted (tested) or the authority is an IP literal (tested).

The once-decoded rule is applied exactly once as specified: triple encodings such as %25252e and an encoded ';' (%3b) or overlong UTF-8 (%c0%ae) pass and are forwarded unchanged (reviewer note, per the requirement's 'every other character is forwarded unchanged').

WebSocket-upgrade pass-through, method-token 400 and CONNECT/TRACE 405 (earlier D-050 steps) are not part of this requirement; the path check is currently the first check in Proxy.handle and later lanes must insert those steps before it.

Review was one independent post-implementation reviewer subagent (tests + 8 axes, fuzzing 3M random targets against a reference implementation: 0 differences); its 3 kept findings were test gaps: K1 and K2 were fixed by new tests, K3 is the servlet limit above.
srs_deltas: SEC-PROXY-001 AC-8: on the TinyHttpd adapter with default ServerOptions, GET http://evil.example/api/orders/x and GET http://h/api/orders/%2e%2e/x get 421 Misdirected Request (TinyHttpd HostAllowlistFilter, DNS-rebinding defence) before middleware, not 400 and not forwarded; no backend connection is opened. Suggest AC-8 allow 'gets 400 or 421 or is forwarded only to the configured target' or state the host is allowlisted. Evidence: ProxyPathChecksTest.sec_PROXY_001_AC8_absoluteFormTargetsOverADefaultTinyHttpdSocket.
